overall_notes: The paper focuses on Arena-Lite, a tournament-based framework for LLM evaluation using LLM-as-a-judge. It compares against baseline-mediated approaches and demonstrates superior reliability with fewer comparisons. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and correction of the automatic metrics answer.
